name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 1.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on creating clear and precise instructions for simple algorithms
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on creating clear and precise instructions for simple algorithms

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 1, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in their home and community, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in their home and community, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the importance of a healthy environment for living and non-living things, and the responsibilities of humans in contributing to a healthy environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the importance of a healthy environment for living and non-living things, and the responsibilities of humans in contributing to a healthy environment

specific_expectations.text: describe changes or problems that could result from the loss of living and non-living things that are part of everyday life, while taking different perspectives into consideration
specific_expectations.text_html: describe changes or problems that could result from the loss of living and non-living things that are part of everyday life, while taking different perspectives into consideration

specific_expectations.text: identify actions that can be taken to contribute to a healthy environment
specific_expectations.text_html: identify actions that can be taken to contribute to a healthy environment

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the basic needs and characteristics of living things, including humans
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the basic needs and characteristics of living things, including humans

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the natural environment as a place where living and non-living things are interconnected
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the natural environment as a place where living and non-living things are interconnected

specific_expectations.text: identify the basic needs of living things, including the need for air, water, food, heat, shelter, and space
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the basic needs of living things, including the need for air, water, food, heat, shelter, and space

specific_expectations.text: identify the physical characteristics of various plants and animals, including humans, and explain how these characteristics help the plants and animals meet their basic needs
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the physical characteristics of various plants and animals, including humans, and explain how these characteristics help the plants and animals meet their basic needs

specific_expectations.text: identify the location and the function of various parts of the human body, including sensory organs
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the location and the function of various parts of the human body, including sensory organs

specific_expectations.text: describe the characteristics of a healthy environment, including clean air and water and nutritious food, and how a healthy environment enables living things to meet their needs
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the characteristics of a healthy environment, including clean air and water and nutritious food, and how a healthy environment enables living things to meet their needs

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which living things provide for the needs of other living things
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which living things provide for the needs of other living things

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess uses of energy at home, at school, and in the community, and suggest ways to use energy responsibly
overall_expectations.text_html: assess uses of energy at home, at school, and in the community, and suggest ways to use energy responsibly

specific_expectations.text: describe everyday uses of energy at school and at home, and suggest ways to use energy responsibly
specific_expectations.text_html: describe everyday uses of energy at school and at home, and suggest ways to use energy responsibly

specific_expectations.text: describe how the lives of people and other living things would be affected if electrical energy were no longer available
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how the lives of people and other living things would be affected if electrical energy were no longer available

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how energy affects their lives, and that the Sun is the principal source of energy for Earth
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how energy affects their lives, and that the Sun is the principal source of energy for Earth

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that energy is the ability to move or change something
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that energy is the ability to move or change something

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that the Sun is Earth’s principal source of energy, including how it warms the air, land, and water; is a source of light for Earth; and makes it possible for plants to grow
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that the Sun is Earth’s principal source of energy, including how it warms the air, land, and water; is a source of light for Earth; and makes it possible for plants to grow

specific_expectations.text: identify food as a source of energy for living things
specific_expectations.text_html: identify food as a source of energy for living things

specific_expectations.text: identify everyday uses of various sources of energy
specific_expectations.text_html: identify everyday uses of various sources of energy

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that humans get the energy resources they need from the world around them, and that the supply of many of these resources is limited
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that humans get the energy resources they need from the world around them, and that the supply of many of these resources is limited

specific_expectations.text: describe seasonal differences in how we use energy and in the forms of energy we use
specific_expectations.text_html: describe seasonal differences in how we use energy and in the forms of energy we use

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impact on people and the environment of everyday objects, including structures, and the materials they are made of
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impact on people and the environment of everyday objects, including structures, and the materials they are made of

specific_expectations.text: identify the kinds of waste materials produced by humans, and plan and carry out a course of action for minimizing waste in the classroom or at home, explaining why each action is important
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the kinds of waste materials produced by humans, and plan and carry out a course of action for minimizing waste in the classroom or at home, explaining why each action is important

specific_expectations.text: assess everyday objects, including structures, that have similar purposes, in terms of the materials they are made from, the source of these materials, and what happens to these objects when they are worn out or no longer needed
specific_expectations.text_html: assess everyday objects, including structures, that have similar purposes, in terms of the materials they are made from, the source of these materials, and what happens to these objects when they are worn out or no longer needed

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that objects, including structures, have observable characteristics and are made from materials with specific properties that determine how they are used
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that objects, including structures, have observable characteristics and are made from materials with specific properties that determine how they are used

specific_expectations.text: describe objects as things that are made of one or more materials
specific_expectations.text_html: describe objects as things that are made of one or more materials

specific_expectations.text: identify structures that are objects designed to support a load, including those acting as supporting frameworks for objects
specific_expectations.text_html: identify structures that are objects designed to support a load, including those acting as supporting frameworks for objects

specific_expectations.text: identify materials that are used to make various everyday objects, including structures
specific_expectations.text_html: identify materials that are used to make various everyday objects, including structures

specific_expectations.text: describe observable characteristics of various everyday objects, including structures, using qualitative information gathered through their senses
specific_expectations.text_html: describe observable characteristics of various everyday objects, including structures, using qualitative information gathered through their senses

specific_expectations.text: describe purposes of everyday objects, including structures
specific_expectations.text_html: describe purposes of everyday objects, including structures

specific_expectations.text: identify properties of materials that enable the objects made from them to perform their intended function
specific_expectations.text_html: identify properties of materials that enable the objects made from them to perform their intended function

specific_expectations.text: identify different kinds of fasteners and describe uses for each
specific_expectations.text_html: identify different kinds of fasteners and describe uses for each

specific_expectations.text: identify sources in nature of some common materials that are used to make various objects, including structures
specific_expectations.text_html: identify sources in nature of some common materials that are used to make various objects, including structures

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impact of daily and seasonal changes on living things, including humans
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of daily and seasonal changes on living things, including humans

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact of daily and seasonal changes on human outdoor activities, and identify innovations that enable people to engage in various activities year-round
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of daily and seasonal changes on human outdoor activities, and identify innovations that enable people to engage in various activities year-round

specific_expectations.text: assess ways in which daily and seasonal changes have an impact on society, the environment, and living things in the natural environment
specific_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which daily and seasonal changes have an impact on society, the environment, and living things in the natural environment

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 1, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of daily and seasonal changes and of how living things respond to those changes
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of daily and seasonal changes and of how living things respond to those changes

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of Earth’s relationship to the Sun and that this relationship results in daily and seasonal changes on Earth
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of Earth’s relationship to the Sun and that this relationship results in daily and seasonal changes on Earth

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that a cycle is a series of repeating events, and that cycles can be observed in daily and seasonal changes
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that a cycle is a series of repeating events, and that cycles can be observed in daily and seasonal changes

specific_expectations.text: describe the changes in the amount of light and heat from the Sun that occur throughout the day and in the four seasons
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the changes in the amount of light and heat from the Sun that occur throughout the day and in the four seasons

specific_expectations.text: describe and compare the four seasons in terms of the weather, including precipitation and temperature, in their local area
specific_expectations.text_html: describe and compare the four seasons in terms of the weather, including precipitation and temperature, in their local area

specific_expectations.text: describe changes in the appearance or behaviour of living things that are adaptations to seasonal changes
specific_expectations.text_html: describe changes in the appearance or behaviour of living things that are adaptations to seasonal changes

specific_expectations.text: describe how humans prepare for, and respond to, daily and seasonal changes
